description: The line plot titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset" illustrates the performance metrics of different model variants in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," is categorical, representing various configurations of the model, including "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," is linear, with values ranging from approximately 56% to 66%. The plot features three lines, each representing a different metric. The "Precision" line is marked with circles and a solid line style, showing a slight decline from 65.78% to 56.82%. The "Recall" line is also marked with circles but with a dashed line style, indicating a more significant decrease from 65.56% to 56.82%. The "F1-score" line, marked with squares and a solid line style, starts at 65.45% and ends at 57.74%, showing a moderate decline. Data points are annotated with their respective values, providing a clear view of the performance at each model variant. The plot does not include any section titles, and the axes are described together before the individual lines are described.
